font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: A single cut at 0.5 auto-closes 37 real threats a
day. Three zones let machines handle the easy ends

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Act: the machine closes it alone. Review: an analyst
checks. Escalate: someone is paged now.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1f2430
font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Kestrel: act below 0.0313, escalate at 0.34 and above

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Write down what each action costs as a function of P.
The cheapest line at each P is your zone.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Six analysts can review 240 alerts a day, not 638.
Queue size is a business decision.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Only honest P can be thresholded
The raw mock’s “almost surely fine” alerts were 2.5×
riskier than it claimed. Recalibrate on recent
history before you trust any line.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Jev gives no reasons, so audit the policy and the
evidence: what it saw, what it said, what you did.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Zone rates, queue size and calibration drift. Audit a random slice of ACT, because otherwise you never see the
mistakes the machine closed on its own. Fail safe to REVIEW, never to ACT.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Next: the patterns that put a decision layer inside real systems.
